The visible rows are all INBOUND: e.g. "2026-02-27 | CROWN NEW MATERIALS TECHNOLOGY CO. | AJIT INDUSTRIES PRIVATE LIMITED | DOUBLE SIDE TISSUE TAPE DS10B/95 REDSUNSUIPRINTED SIZE:1240MM X 1000M P636-RED (39 ROLLS) (FOR INDUSTRIAL USE) | Nansha, CHINA -> GARI HARSARU ICD INGHR6, India | 48114100 | BOL 7777927". The page's own 'Buyers' block lists counterparties (AIPL TAPES INDUSTRY LLC, Umm Al Quwain UAE; STAPLE MARK PVT LTD, Colombo Sri Lanka; AIPL ABRO INDUSTRIES LIMITED, Lagos Nigeria; PANCHAKANYA DMEX PVT LTD, Nepal) but gives NO dated export record, no destination-country shipment line, no export HS code and no export B/L number — only aggregate counterparty counts (103 / 46 / 36 / 82). No dated outbound bill of lading was found in any accessible free view. Source counter: ImportKey claims 7760 total shipments; rows actually seen = 5 import rows on the /ajit-industries-private-limited page plus 5 import rows on the /ajit-industries-pvt-ltd page (10 rows total, 0 export rows).
domestic_evidence: No GST turnover band, GeM/CPPP tender award, contract or annual-report domestic/export split could be retrieved. web_search returned no results (searx connection refused) on both attempts, and eximpedia.app and trademo.com returned HTTP 403, so no domestic-supply record was read. null — not public in the sources reachable within this check.
note: Ajit Industries Private Limited is a real, active adhesive-tape converter (self-adhesive tape / double-side tissue tape, HS 48114100 and 39199090) with heavy, dated and B/L-numbered IMPORT activity from China (Crown New Materials Technology, Gtech Technology, Fujian Youyi Adhesive Tape Group, Glacier Sun Industries) through Nhava Sheva and Gari Harsaru ICD, latest record 2026-02-27. That confirms it is an operating manufacturer/trader with real goods flow, but it is INBOUND flow. For the declared HS 481141 the customs record is import-side only: the company buys 48114100 double-side tissue tape from China, it was not observed shipping 481141 out of India. Outbound trade is suggested only by the counterparty list (UAE, Sri Lanka, Nigeria, Nepal buyers) with no dated shipment line, so export_status is declared_only, not confirmed. Domestic supply: no evidence found either way — stated as unknown, not as 'conditionally accepted'. No rejection grounds: the entity exists and is trading; sanctions/court matters are not rejection grounds per project rules. Revenue and export volume: null — no public figure found, not estimated.
